# dify_dataset (Resource)

Manages a Dify knowledge base (dataset). The dataset stores documents and supports retrieval-augmented generation. `retrieval_model` is a JSON string passed through to the API. Import by id: `terraform import dify_dataset.x <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a knowledge base (dataset).
resource "dify_dataset" "kb" {
  name                     = "My Knowledge Base"
  description              = "Documents for RAG retrieval."
  indexing_technique       = "high_quality"
  permission               = "all_team_members"
  provider_type            = "vendor"
  embedding_model          = "text-embedding-v3"
  embedding_model_provider = "jina"
}

variable "retrieval_model" {
  type    = string
  default = ""
}

# retrieval_model is passed as a JSON string when set.
locals {
  retrieval_model = var.retrieval_model != "" ? var.retrieval_model : jsonencode({
    reranking_model = {
      reranking_provider_name = "jina"
      reranking_model_name    = "jina-reranker-v1"
    }
    top_n = 3
  })
}

# Create a document from a local file in the dataset.
resource "dify_dataset_document" "doc" {
  dataset_id    = dify_dataset.kb.id
  name          = "Example Document"
  text          = file("${path.module}/document.md")
  doc_form      = "text_model"
  doc_language  = "English"
  indexing_wait = true
}

# Optionally wait explicitly when indexing_wait is disabled on the document.
resource "dify_dataset_document_indexing_wait" "wait" {
  dataset_id       = dify_dataset_document.doc.dataset_id
  document_id      = dify_dataset_document.doc.id
  timeout          = 600
  polling_interval = 5

  depends_on = [dify_dataset_document.doc]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the knowledge base (1-40 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the knowledge base.
- `embedding_model` (String) Embedding model name. Use the `model` field from Get Available Models with `model_type=text-embedding`.
- `embedding_model_provider` (String) Embedding model provider. Use the `provider` field from Get Available Models with `model_type=text-embedding`.
- `external_knowledge_api_id` (String) ID of the external knowledge API (when `provider` is `external`).
- `external_knowledge_id` (String) ID of the external knowledge base (when `provider` is `external`).
- `indexing_technique` (String) `high_quality` uses embedding models for precise search; `economy` uses keyword-based indexing.
- `permission` (String) `only_me` restricts access to the creator, `all_team_members` grants workspace-wide access, `partial_members` grants access to specified members.
- `provider_type` (String) `vendor` for internal knowledge bases, `external` for external ones.
- `retrieval_model` (String) Retrieval model configuration as a JSON string. Controls how chunks are searched and ranked.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix seconds when the dataset was created.
- `id` (String) Dataset ID (assigned by Dify).
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix seconds when the dataset was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Dataset resources are imported by dataset ID.
terraform import dify_dataset.kb <dataset_id>
```
